sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 220. Success value 100. 5x physical damage (Wind).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Reduces fixed damage taken to 0 (1 time only).
-Target: all allies. Applies 50% elevation for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies iron wall for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies the following effect for 60 seconds: Recovers 5 Cost when using an Ability.
-Target: all allies excluding yourself. Fills Unison gauge by 30.
-Target: yourself. Applies blessing (recovers 50 Cost, increases max HP by 100%, nullifies status ailments and Unison Gauge reduction effects, reduces cooldown times by 50%, and recovers 20% of max HP every 5 seconds) for 100 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 15000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 15000
